text:
ci-bot: ALERT: nightly-ci/perf-bench p95 for rtx-serve-48 jumped ~28% vs baseline in run nightly-2024-03-06T03Z. job: https://ci.redwood/inventories/9843/artifacts — sample traces attached.

maya: ack, thanks. which test config triggered this? small-batch or default?

ashok: saw the same. appears after merge of d3f7b8c into runtime-scheduler (around 02:40Z). rough diff looks like scheduler backpressure tweak.

lina: can someone repro locally with the nightly profile flags? try: ```scripts/bench/run.sh --model rtx-serve-48 --batch 8 --seq 512 --profile --prof-sample 250```

kevin: i can start a bisect if we need. maya, can you grab the artifact with full kv snapshot? job id in artifact link is 9843.

maya: grabbing now. downloading trace.tar.gz -> uploaded to /private/scratch/maya/9843-trace.tar.gz. running a repro with --prof-sample.

ops-sentry-bot: Logs for job 9843: https://logs.redwood/9843. Error rate unchanged, only latency spike on p95.

ashok: quick check: if the scheduler tweak added an extra wait on slow-path, p95 would jump but p50 stay. that's what we're seeing.

kevin: if we confirm scheduler change, safest rollback is to revert d3f7b8c on the nightly branch and run a canary. can someone try a rollback in a non-prod branch?

lina: I pushed a patch (revert-scheduler-smallfix) to my fork. CI run queued: https://ci.redwood/inventories/9850. will report perf numbers when green.

maya: repro trace shows a spike in kernel scheduling at sample 1200..1300, attaching snippet: ```cpu_wait_ms: [0.9, 1.2, 12.7, 0.8, 0.7]```

kevin: good catch. can you run with env DEBUG_SCHED=1 and upload full logs? that should show where the wait is introduced.

maya: running with DEBUG_SCHED=1 now. ETA ~6m.

ashok: i can instrument the scheduler in a dev build to log latency buckets. dropping a quick patch now.

ci-bot: NOTE: nightly-run-9843 had fallback policy disabled; if rollback confirmed we should re-enable auto-fallback for nightly canaries.

lina: 9850 passed smoke, but perf run still pending.

kevin: once maya uploads DEBUG_SCHED logs, i'll do a quick bisect between d3f7b8c and parent. if we find culprit, we'll gate the change.

maya: uploaded logs: https://artifacts.redwood/maya/9843/debug_sched.log.gz. short excerpt: "hold_ms=12.4 at scheduler::maybe_yield()"

ashok: that function was touched in d3f7b8c to reduce context switches. looks like the condition flip caused a rare long-hold. i'll open an immediate fix.

lina: perf run for revert branch (9850) finished: p95 delta -1.2% vs baseline (so the revert looks promising). full numbers: https://ci.redwood/9850/report

kevin: thanks. plan: ashok will send a small patch to avoid the pathological path, lina will run another perf run on patch branch, maya will validate traces. if green, we merge and cherry-pick to main. assigning owner: ashok.

ashok: on it, will have PR up in ~30m.

maya: thanks all — I'll follow up with final traces and drop a short postmortem in #postmortems after we close. :thumbsup:

kevin: :eyes: great triage. reopening if any surprises.
